verdict.rationale: Baseten docs say Model APIs expose OpenAI-compatible endpoints that support the OpenAI Chat Completions API, so you can use familiar client SDKs. The structured-outputs docs show an OpenAI client (LangChain's ChatOpenAI) working by pointing base_url at Baseten. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party OpenAI SDK example showing only base_url and api_key changing, evidence of compatibility beyond Chat Completions, and independent or hands-on confirmation of drop-in behavior.
